facts.value: The source-level stage configuration comprises grTPk_StageCallbacks, a four-element StageCallbacks array with three populated records and a final all-null/zero record, and grTPk_StageData, a StageData descriptor referencing that array. These declarations do not establish compiled section membership, writability or relative placement.
facts.rationale: Preserves the directly supported typed-object knowledge while removing an unsupported compiled-section/layout assertion.

facts.value: Takes no explicit input and returns no value. It passes grTPikachu_80222F20 to Ground_InitTargetStage, whose inline clears stage_info.unk8C.b4, sets b5, invokes that supplied installer for IDs 0, 1 and 2 without checking its results, then calls four shared Ground setup routines. The supplied installer selects grTPk_StageCallbacks[id], obtains the Ground GObj, and either performs callback setup or reports lookup failure before returning the nullable result. Successful setup establishes the GX link, stores callback3 when present, invokes on_init immediately and schedules gobj_proc; this setup path does not consume callback1 or record flags.
facts.rationale: Distinguishes the shared initializer from its ID-taking callback and records the actual cross-file callback installation and scheduling behavior.

evidence.why: Exact callback consumers, scheduling, numeric state writes and initialization sequence.

facts.value: A parameterless stage-start callback with signature void grTpikachu_UnkStage0_OnStart(void), registered in grTPk_StageData. It returns no value and returns normally after its generator-initialization call; it is not a noreturn function.
facts.rationale: Corrects the distinction between returning no value and never returning control.

evidence.why: Callee returns on both GObj creation outcomes.
